note: Versions of yaapi.bible a patch may use, checked by hand (20 nov 2026). Order = preference. `license` is what a person confirmed; the build fails if yaapi's own `license` field disagrees. SPAPDDPT: yaapi CCBY, eBible.org (publisher's distribution) CC BY 4.0 with 'Copyright 2020 Asociacion Biblica Latinoamericana'; Bible.com's page says CC BY-SA 4.0 (conflict, not resolved by the publisher). ONBV-AST: Biblica's own notice (via eBible.org) says CC BY-SA 4.0 and asks for the notice below.

versions.notice: Biblica® Open Nueva Biblia Viva™ Copyright © 2006, 2008 by Biblica, Inc. “Biblica” is a trademark registered in the United States Patent and Trademark Office by Biblica, Inc. Used with permission. The original Work by its copyright holders is available for free at www.biblica.com and open.bible.

excluded.VBL: licence field CCBYND, text says CC BY-SA 4.0 (contradiction)
excluded.BLT: licence field CCBYND, text says CC BY-SA 4.0 (contradiction)
excluded.TOJB: field CCBY but the copyright text has no license wording
excluded.ASV: field CCBYNC, text says public domain
excluded.BSB: field CCBYNCND, text says public domain
